notes: Data-source labels shown under every chart and table. Labels are worked out from the data itself: the URL stored with each downloaded observation, or how a workbook cell was produced (Bloomberg formula, manual input or workbook calculation).
To label a new site, add a provider with its domains. Downloads from a domain not listed here are labelled with the site's host name.
preference: when the same metric is available from more than one provider (see equivalents), the earlier provider is used.

equivalents: opt-in only. Maps an independent series id (for example a FRED id) to the workbook series that measures the same thing in the same units and frequency. Leave empty until PCM confirms each pair.

workbook.manual: PCM - Monthly Market & Risk Monitor (manual input)
